checks.finding: For equal signs rhoN(a)-rhoN(b) is exactly the number of opposite-sign indices strictly between them. All compact factors increase, the remaining pq factors are at most A, and WpWq<=Wn. Empty and rank-one products are handled. DC1/DC10/DC13 supply the same lowest compact type.

The numerical bound forces h>16384(pq)^3>32npq+2 and exceeds max(npq+1,16n min(p,q)+8sqrt(2min(p,q))). General existence is correctly cited to DC1–DC12 under (DC.2), and DC19 covers every literal IsDS. cdScaleTie and dsigTie concern the very same source Haar measure and parameter. The zero eventual threshold is permitted because FamP.ties holds at every x,i.

Original SizeN/M/K bounds with epsilon/100 margins imply the displayed polynomial rank bounds. FamCore.Ix_zero and L_eps justify 0<epsilon<1/52. Fixed positive epsilon permits eventual 5log x<=x^epsilon and exp(x^(epsilon/3))>=2x. No rank, Delta, word or place is selected after the threshold.

Original cloud equations and hcW_first/last are preserved. Both +/- (k-1)/2 top endpoint shifts are retained. SizeRho and SizeBot give bT<=5Bprime/4. The thick upper window is B+eta+1. With B>=e and eta<=B/27 this is <=2B. The top and thin bounds use the literal windows, not a replacement equally spaced model.

SizeEta and kS<=wpp, k>=3x give (x+1)eta<=wpp and xS<=wpp/3; hence xS+eta<=wpp, b_j>=x eta and S<=b0/x. Interlacing, integral column gaps, and nodes_gap/SizeNodes verify actual DataB/PlaceData. The row signs put the first negative bottom index at 1, so all noncompact differences meet the displayed gap. The bound 9*8192*r^9 safely dominates the delta=1/3 threshold.

The exact finite-group cardinalities yield exponent Bm=m(2k+m-1)/2 and remaining Euler factors j=k+1,...,r. The sum of the adjacent mass exponents is Am=(m-1)k+m(m-1)/2. The factorial factors cancel exactly against the two Vandermonde denominators. All logs are of positive values on the original field.

Interior differences satisfy u_i-u_j>=Delta(4(j-i)-1); the numerator difference is 4Delta(j-i). Grouping by d gives sum(n-d)/(3d)<=k(1+log k)/3. Exactly k-2 cloud factors remain; cloud-bottom and bottom-bottom counts are (k-1)m and m(m-1)/2. Omitted column endpoint factors are >=1 by the actual integral weight. The total is <=(13/3)kmL<=5kmL.

Upper coefficients are 3/2 from Am, 1/2 from the Euler bound, 5 from Vandermondes, and 3C0 from Bm G, giving (7+3C0)mL. QW6 applies on the checked same coordinates and gives 16mL-Ceps(L+m^2L/k). Since m^2L<=k and L>=1, choosing m>=2Ceps gives 15mL. All maxima precede members, words and places. Gam_eq and SizeKRel imply log Gamma<=fk; the same actual prime window then gives X-2<=log T<=X+1. The source cTmin=max(11,16+3max(5,CYL+1)) remains unchanged.

Built is an equality of the entire dependent (D,O,b) triple. The original Core.real survives setDiv because the four RealTied fields are unchanged. RSL1–RSL3 identify the actual Y0 volume with massI. Link.pos discharges QOf positivity on cls; for arbitrary A,sigma the explicit IsSel hypothesis supplies the same Built witnesses, so the universal Row.of_sel premise is proved. Literal subclass projections retain the selected family.

Closed has outer epsilon1=1 and zero TransportedAlt chosen before Fm,CH; the rank/size thresholds may depend on the supplied family. The construction-class result proves a property of every member and does not prove nonemptiness or an arbitrary FamP volume identity. The common DesignChoices producer and inherited HC-Deg/GV-TAM/MF-HM applications remain explicit.
